WITH driver_counts AS (
  SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_record_count
  FROM qualifying
  GROUP BY driverId
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(qualifying_record_count) AS average_record_count
  FROM driver_counts
)
SELECT dc.driverId,
       dc.qualifying_record_count AS count,
       1.0 * dc.qualifying_record_count / oa.average_record_count AS ratio
FROM driver_counts AS dc
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
ORDER BY ratio DESC, dc.driverId
LIMIT 10;
